basis: Suggested rotations derived from ability mechanics. Replay lineups, tiers and maps are reference metadata, not transcribed turn orders or verified deployment tiles.

Avatar of Khaine.rule: Leave the marked fire lane before the delayed strike. Wrath can push adjacent characters away; rebuild the buff formation afterward.
Avatar of Khaine.position: Reserve a safe exit from fire for each melee character; survival takes priority over holding high ground.

Belisarius Cawl.rule: Exit Solar Atomizer's marked lane. Arc Scourge chains through adjacent units and gains Machine Vengeance for Mechanical units hit.
Belisarius Cawl.position: Keep an escape lane from the two-hex-wide beam; bringing Mechanical substitutes changes the risk of this formation.

Ghazghkull.rule: Prophet of Gork and Mork counts attacks, not individual hits. Spend the remaining allowance on Kariyan and Laviscus before low-value attacks; supporting battles can change that allowance.
Ghazghkull.position: Move out of marked charge and firing lanes. Do not crowd the highest-health melee target with fragile allies.

Hive Tyrant.rule: Check the hive-fleet variant: Gorgon erodes armour, Kronos punishes nearby Psyker abilities, and Leviathan can revive adjacent allies. Catalyst temporarily raises defence.
Hive Tyrant.position: Keep the melee route clear of adds; reassess survival after armour loss rather than following the rotation blindly.

Magnus.rule: Check Gaze before attacking: its marked character takes damage if it attacks Magnus, and Psykers are punished regardless. Every ninth attack also faces Impossible Form.
Magnus.position: Rebuild adjacency when Magnus moves; the marked character may need to skip its boss attack to survive.

Mortarion.rule: His aura damages adjacent units at the start of his turn, and summons take double damage. Reaping Scythe splashes around its target and prefers Psykers; later hits in an attack suffer diminishing damage.
Mortarion.position: Avoid placing fragile characters beside the likely Scythe target. Check remaining health before keeping anyone in melee for another round.

Screamer-Killer.rule: Normal attacks splash around their target. Death Scream and Living Battering Ram can stun or displace the formation; the defeated supporting battles affect those stuns.
Screamer-Killer.position: Keep fragile damage dealers away from the intended tank's neighbouring hexes where possible. Recheck Aesoth range and boss adjacency after a throw.

Szarekh.rule: Charging loses hits through Obeisance Generators. Keep your damage dealers in contact when safe, and leave the lit Annihilator Beam hexes before his next turn.
Szarekh.position: Limited throne-side melee hexes make access important. Reserve legal adjacent hexes for Kariyan, Trajann and Laviscus; a throne-exit bait is map-specific, not guaranteed.

Tervigon.rule: Critical hits on the boss also damage nearby Termagants through Synaptic Backlash. Catalyst temporarily raises defence; the hive-fleet variant changes the other hazards.
Tervigon.position: Keep the boss's neighbouring hexes accessible. Clear a blocking add when needed, while leaving Laviscus beside the enemy your high-damage characters will hit.
